name: Barsik
description: Affectionate and social. Loves sleeping on the keyboard and greeting guests at the door.

name: Ryzhik
description: A true sunny cat. Purrs the loudest and is always ready to chase a laser.

name: Murka
description: Independent beauty. Loves watching from the windowsill and playing with a ribbon.

name: Snezhok
description: White and fluffy like a cloud. Shy, but loves being petted more than anything.

name: Ten
description: A mysterious black cat. Appears silently and disappears the moment you look away.

name: Laska
description: The most gentle cat in the house. Sleeps only on pillows and loves attention.
